query: What does AWS reported backlog include

output.content:
AWS’s reported “backlog” is Amazon’s **remaining performance obligations**: the unrecognized value of signed customer contracts for services not yet delivered, and it is **primarily AWS-related**. [[1]] 

Amazon’s disclosed measure includes only customer contracts with **original terms longer than one year**. [[2]] 

Accordingly, it represents contracted future AWS revenue that will be recognized as AWS provides the contracted services, rather than a measure of current-quarter revenue, cash received, or all potential cloud demand. [[3]] 

It generally excludes cancellable arrangements and pay-as-you-go/on-demand consumption not covered by qualifying long-term commitments, so it is not a complete forecast of AWS revenue. [[4]]
